title: Bath Time in the Garden
setting: A sunny garden with pink flowers, a tub of water and Max, the family dog.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Max
characters.look: Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar)

sentences.en: It is a warm June day in the garden.
sentences.zh: 六月的一天，花园里很暖和。
sentences.scene_prompt: A sunny garden in early summer with green grass, pink flowers and a tub of water.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a sunny summer garden; the month can't be shown.

sentences.en: Ben and Lily want to give Max a bath.
sentences.zh: 本和莉莉想给麦克斯洗个澡。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) hold Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) next to a tub of soapy water in the garden.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children about to bath the dog; 'want' can only be guessed.

sentences.en: Wet Max runs twelve times around the pink flowers.
sentences.zh: 湿漉漉的麦克斯绕着粉色的花跑了十二圈。
sentences.scene_prompt: Wet Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) races around a bed of pink flowers while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) chase him with a towel.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Max running around the flowers; the number of times is not shown.

sentences.en: He is nine, but he runs like a puppy.
sentences.zh: 它九岁了，可跑起来还像只小狗崽。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) leaps in the air like a young puppy, water drops flying.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Max jumping playfully; his age is not shown.

sentences.en: Lily waits for a moment until he stops.
sentences.zh: 莉莉等了一会儿，直到它停下来。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) waits with a towel as Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) finally sits still on the grass.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily waiting; 'until' is not shown.

sentences.en: Each child takes a turn with the brush.
sentences.zh: 每个孩子轮流用刷子给它刷毛。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) brushes Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) while Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) waits with the brush ready for her turn.

sentences.en: Later, they share a banana, piece by piece.
sentences.zh: 后来，他们一块一块地分吃一根香蕉。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) sit on the grass sharing pieces of a banana; Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) watches hopefully.

sentences.en: "Help yourself to another piece," Ben tells Max.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) holds out a piece of banana to Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar), who sniffs it.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben offering banana to Max; the words are not shown.
